surface_mechanism_description: The process for the SALE deposition of AIN closely resembles the procedure used by Dapkus et al. for the deposition of InAs and GaAs. Triethylaluminum (TEA) and ammonia (NH3) were used as precursors with hydrogen as the carrier gas. Similar to GaN ALE, the sapphire substrate was alternatively subjected to TEA and NH3 pulses with the carrier gas on all the time.
evidence: The process we employ for the SALE deposition of AIN is similar to that described earlier for GaN. It closely resembles the procedure used by Dapkus et al. for the deposition of InAs and GaAs. Triethylaluminum (TEA) and ammonia (NH3) were used as precursors with hydrogen as the carrier gas. Similar to GaN ALE, the sapphire substrate was alternatively subjected to TEA and NH3 pulses with the carrier gas on all the time.
